USEFUL DETAILS
How do I book?

Select a vehicle and service, then open the live Acuity calendar. Available times, passenger details and final confirmation are handled by the company’s booking system.

Can I book an ATL airport transfer?

Yes. The booking menu includes ATL arrival and departure transfers for Sedan, SUV and Sprinter categories. Select the appropriate direction when booking.

What are the listed rates?

Hourly one-hour listings are $165 for Luxury Sedan, $197 for Luxury SUV and $550 for Luxury Sprinter. ATL transfer listings vary by category and direction; the full service menu shows all nine options.

What information do I need for pickup?

Have your date and time, pickup and destination, passenger and luggage counts, and any flight details ready. Confirm any special pickup requirements with the company.

Can I choose a specific make or model?

Vehicle categories are available to select. Confirm the exact vehicle model, seating, luggage capacity and amenities with the company before booking.

How do I arrange additional stops or time?

Contact the company with your itinerary before booking. Additional time, stops and any associated charges require confirmation.

What are the cancellation and payment terms?

Review the terms presented in the live booking system and confirm any questions with the company before completing your reservation. No cancellation fees or deposits are specified on this site.

Can you accommodate child seating or accessibility needs?

Email your requirements before booking. Availability and suitability need to be confirmed for your journey.
